rationale: The agent verified identity using full name and ZIP via the tool before accessing account data. It reviewed all orders and correctly identified the relevant pending order. It explicitly confirmed the exact items to cancel and the refund destination before attempting any changes. When the modify tool failed and indicated only one-to-one exchanges were supported (no partial removals), the agent did not fabricate a successful change; instead, it transparently explained limitations and offered policy-compliant alternatives (full order cancellation or exchanges). The user opted to keep the order unchanged. The agent then sought explicit confirmation before updating the default profile address and executed that change correctly, confirming the result. No writes were performed without confirmation, no actions were taken on the wrong account, and no unsupported claims about order status or refunds were made that affected outcomes. Minor note: mentioning a typical PayPal refund timeframe was extra but did not lead to incorrect actions, and the cancellation ultimately did not proceed.
